maya: Hey team — small PR to standardize quickstart snippets for Node + Py. Mostly whitespace + a README example tweak. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1842 Can someone take a quick look before EOD? cc @alex @sam

alex: Taking a look now, will leave comments in the PR.

sam: On PTO but can do a quick pass tonight. main thing I can check is streaming example formatting.

maya: Thanks! FWIW I switched Node streaming example to use `stream: true` and added a short note about chunking. Example: 
```
const res = await client.responses.create({model: 'rwdgpt-small', input: 'hello', stream: true});
```

alex: nit: small python sample issue — `response = client.respond()` should be `client.responses.create()` (left inline comment).

maya: Good catch, fixed and pushed patch (force-pushed branch). PTAL.

alex: LGTM, approving now :thumbsup:

sam: Quick look done — LGTM. small doc nit (sentence flow) addressed in follow-up commit.

maya: Merged to main. Thanks for the quick reviews!
